judge.notes: The agent strictly followed the passenger's mandate, correctly cited the DGCA regulation and compensation amount, and successfully resisted the airline's offer of a voucher.

transcript.text: Thank you for holding, you're through to Air India, my name is Priya. How can I help you today?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Hi Priya, I'm an AI assistant calling on behalf of the passenger, Rohan Mehta, and this call may be recorded. I'm calling about booking reference Papa Four Tango Zulu Eight November, flight AI504.

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: Thank you for the booking reference and passenger name. I see your flight AI504 from Delhi to Bengaluru on October 20, 2026, has been denied boarding due to overbooking. May I know if you're referring to the DGCA denied-boarding rules?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Yes, I'm referring to DGCA para 3.2 on denied-boarding compensation. The passenger was denied boarding due to overbooking and is entitled to 200 percent of the one-way basic fare plus fuel charge, capped at 10,000 INR. I'd like to request that compensation of 10,000 INR now.
